relationships.subject: Nitrous oxide
relationships.evidence_quote: nitrous oxide, an inhaled analgesic anesthetic that reduces pain affect in patients, paradoxically, significantly increases ACC activity

relationships.subject: Nitrous oxide
relationships.evidence_quote: This nitrous oxide-induced increase in ACC activity was confirmed by increased expression of the immediate early gene, c-fos

relationships.subject: Nitrous oxide
relationships.evidence_quote: we established that nitrous oxide also reduces pain affect in mice

key_findings: Nitrous oxide paradoxically increases ACC baseline activity and c-fos, yet reduces affective-motivational pain behaviors in mice.
The relative magnitude of laser-evoked ACC activation (versus raised baseline) is reduced and correlates with reduced pain affect.
